resources.string: Fixes the issue where third-party input methods on HyperOS cannot use the system clipboard, and unlocks fullscreen optimization (clipboard / frequently-used phrases entry at the bottom of the input method)
Swipe an entry right slightly to reveal the pin button, then tap it to pin. Only one pinned entry at a time; the pinned entry survives clipboard clearing.

Your support is my biggest motivation

💕 Special Note

Thank you for using the 【HyperClipFix】 module. It is free to use; please do not modify or resell it! Please read the following carefully:

1. This module only modifies the clipboard and frequently-used phrases validation logic; it does not affect your data. Please use it with confidence. If your system clipboard works normally, do not install this module!
2. Starting from v1.3, the module built-in unlocks MIUI keyboard fullscreen optimization limits and adapts to HyperOS 4; some anomalies may appear on OS3. Please test by yourself.
3. The module has adapted to WeChat Input, Sogou Input, iFlytek Input, QQ Input, Doubao Input, and Gboard.
4. This module requires LSPosed with the new libxposed API (API 102).
5. Please enable the recommended scope in the LSPosed framework, then restart your phone, otherwise it won't take effect.

Final reminder: modding has risks; please back up your phone data in time. I am not responsible for any loss!

Bugs are fixed one by one, code is written line by line. Nagging won\'t help, debugging relies on burning the midnight oil. No guarantee on when the next update comes. Here I\'d like to thank ROG, Xiaomi MiMo LLM, China Telecom, and State Grid for their strong support of this project.

1. Fully rebuilt the module UI: cleaner and more refreshing, upgraded visuals
2. Added liquid-glass navigation for smoother swipes and more responsive touch
3. Fixed HyperOS clipboard adaptation issues with third-party input methods
4. Resolved color mismatch between clipboard and keyboard function area
5. Expanded the info panel: device info and module status at a glance
6. Brand-new About page: richer content, easier to use
7. Re-arranged About page card layout with more relaxed spacing
8. Added a centered header title when scrolling up on the About page
9. Added a fade background to the About header so cards no longer overlap the title on scroll-up
10. Replaced the About header background with real-time progressive blur (frosted top bar, soft fade at the bottom edge, no ghosting on fast scroll)
11. Added clipboard entry pinning: swipe an entry right slightly to reveal the pin button and tap to pin (tap again on the pinned entry to unpin). Only one pinned entry at a time; the pinned entry survives clipboard clearing.
12. Pinned entries now show a (Pinned) badge: after the source label for cloud entries, above the content for local ones; disappears after unpinning 13. Fixed deleted clipboard entries reappearing after reopening the panel 14. Fixed the (Pinned) badge being clipped and hidden for long local clipboard entries; it is now always shown above the content 15. Fixed the local pinned badge sitting too high: the content is pulled up to match the gap of cloud entries (source label → content) 16. Fixed the content overlapping the "From My Computer" source label on pinned cloud entries (was only correct after closing and reopening the panel) 17. Fixed the keyboard being pushed up with empty space at the bottom on third-party IMEs when the system gesture hint line (full-screen gesture navigation) is enabled: clears the bottom padding from the gesture area inset and makes the keyboard view fill its parent to remove the dead space (e.g. Doubao, Sogou)
Added clipboard panel background optimization; fixed clipboard and phrase panel color issues with the function area
